verdict.rationale: Greptile's TREX feature runs a PR branch in a sandbox. It starts services, mocks inputs, clicks through UI flows and leaves logs, screenshots and traces on the PR, so code can be tested at runtime in isolation rather than against live systems. This rests on a single marketing-page claim and covers sandboxed runtime testing of user code, not a dedicated sandbox or test mode for Greptile's own integrations. Missing for 10: docs on TREX sandbox isolation and data handling (whether production data and credentials are excluded), a test/sandbox mode for Greptile's own API or MCP integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
